name: The Heart of Chechnya Mosque
description: Named after the first president of the Chechen Republic, Akhmad Kadyrov, it is one of the largest mosques in Europe and the world, with a capacity of tens of thousands of people. The Islamic complex covers a total area of ​​14 acres, and the summer gallery and square next to it can also allow tens of thousands of believers to pray at the same time. Around the Heart of Chechnya stand four minarets (the tallest in Russia) with a height of 63 meters. Turkish masters used high-quality gold to paint Quranic imagery on the walls of mosques.
